description: This file provides a thread-local connection manager for a MySQL database using mysql-connector-python. It includes functions for configuration, obtaining connections, executing queries, and fetching results, specifically tailored for managing per-thread database connections in a Python backend application.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_env(var_name: str, default: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Helper to read environment variables with a default value.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _db_config()
methods.description: Builds database configuration from environment variables.

methods.name: get_connection()
methods.description: Obtains or creates a thread-local MySQL connection.

methods.name: close_connection()
methods.description: Closes the thread-local connection if it exists.

methods.name: int execute(query: str, params: Optional[tuple] = None)
methods.description: Executes a write SQL query with optional parameters, commits, and returns affected row count.

methods.name: Optional[tuple] fetch_one(query: str, params: Optional[tuple] = None)
methods.description: Executes a select query and returns a single row or None.

methods.name: List[tuple] fetch_all(query: str, params: Optional[tuple] = None)
methods.description: Executes a select query and returns all rows as a list of tuples.

ctags.pattern: /^def execute(query: str, params: Optional[tuple] = None) -> int:$/

ctags.pattern: /^def fetch_all(query: str, params: Optional[tuple] = None) -> List[tuple]:$/

ctags.pattern: /^def fetch_one(query: str, params: Optional[tuple] = None) -> Optional[tuple]:$/
